name: Anneliese Schmidt
bio:
Anneliese Schmidt's journey in motorsport began in her youth, tinkering with engines in her father's garage in rural Bavaria. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering and quickly found her way into the world of racing. Her early career saw her working on various touring car teams before transitioning to single-seaters. She is known for her meticulous approach to data analysis and her ability to translate complex technical information into actionable insights for the drivers. Anneliese is respected for her calm demeanor under pressure and her knack for finding unconventional solutions to challenging problems.

After several successful years with larger teams, Anneliese decided to join MP Motorsport Junior, drawn to the opportunity to mentor young talent and contribute to the development of future racing stars. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every member of the team feels empowered to contribute their best. Her flexible approach and willingness to adapt to new technologies make her a valuable asset to the team, especially as the sport continues to evolve. She hopes to shape the next generation of racing engineers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob, slightly wavy
physical.description: A petite woman with a kind face and intelligent eyes that reflect her decades of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten calculations and observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of German gummy bears available in the garage at all times; shares them generously.
